sources.title: GitHub - NeoAiLabs/GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3
sources.snippet: Run turboderp/GLM-5.3-Flash-exl3 at 2.05 bpw on an NVIDIA DGX Spark. ExLlamaV3 is the inference engine; TabbyAPI provides the OpenAI-compatible API. This deployment is specific to Linux ARM64, NVIDIA GB10/SM121a, CUDA 13, and approximately 128 GB of unified memory. It is not an x86 image.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 Flash EXL3 for 2-4x DGX Sparks - GitHub
sources.snippet: A 3× sibling is ./start-tp3.sh on the same image and weights (see 3× Spark (TP=3)). Served model id: GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3. EXL3/TR3 quant by brandonmusic. Optional TP3 contribution for evaluation: cooperative ABI2, 64-row support, FlashKDA and combined-profile measurements.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash (Experimental) - vLLM Ascend
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash (Experimental) 1 Introduction ¶ GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. Built on a hybrid architecture that combines sparse and linear attention for the first time in the GLM series, it adopts Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and is trained on a 30T-token multimodal pre-training corpus.
